snippet.title: Buhei Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to dive into Buhei, the fast-paced twin-stick party shooter for up to 8 players.
Play locally or via Steam Remote Play.
Fight with crazy weapons.
Choose wild abilities.
Customize your characters.
Wreak havoc, outsmart opponents, and revel in chaotic fun.

🔗 Want to join the action?
Add Buhei to your Steam Wishlist now — get notified the moment it’s live:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2457310?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=release&utm_medium=trailer
